proposals.before: When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.
proposals.after: When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support.
proposals.reason: Corrects the misspelling Meritious to Meritorious in the honorific title.

proposals.before: When Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Yulili greatly helped bring it about; he then administered Northern Court privy affairs and was granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.
proposals.after: When Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Yulili greatly helped bring it about; he then administered Northern Court privy affairs and was granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support.
proposals.reason: Corrects the same Meritious misspelling in the literal rendering.

decisions.reason: 賜推誠協贊功臣 grants an honorific whose 功臣 is English Meritorious Subject; Meritious is a misspelling, and Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support correctly renders the title without changing other sense.
The literal field has the same misspelling Meritious for 功臣; correcting to Meritorious matches the Chinese honorific and leaves the rest of the literal rendering intact.
